spec_refs: Modbus Messaging on TCP/IP Implementation Guide V1.0b

patterns.summary: MBAP Length field declares larger payload than actually sent; parser reads beyond received bytes.
patterns.fuzzer_notes: Already covered by length_overflow, length_too_long, length_too_short, length_boundary requests under Modbus_MBAP_Testing group (see modbus/tcp.py:1226). The audit-gap claim was an oversight.

patterns.summary: Vendor-specific function code ranges 65-72 and 100-110 often lack input validation.
patterns.fuzzer_notes: ALL_FUNCTION_CODES in modbus/constants.py already covers these; verified.

patterns.summary: Quantity field exceeds spec max (125 for read holding, 2000 for read coils).
patterns.fuzzer_notes: boofuzz default mutation of Word covers these via boundary set.

patterns.summary: Exception code field > 0x0B causes array out-of-bounds in master-side parsers.
patterns.fuzzer_notes: Covered via boofuzz Byte() mutation on exception code field.

patterns.summary: Write_Multiple_Registers / _Coils byte_count field inconsistent with quantity field.
patterns.fuzzer_notes: Covered via boofuzz Byte() mutation; explicit pattern documented for future bias.

patterns.summary: RTU slaves that don't validate CRC accept any frame; CRC validation path is never exercised when boofuzz Checksum() auto-recomputes.
patterns.fuzzer_notes: Need a new Request that uses Static() for the CRC instead of Checksum(). One-off.

patterns.summary: ADU larger than spec max (260 bytes) crashes implementations that allocate fixed buffers.
patterns.fuzzer_notes: Covered via boofuzz String/Bytes overflow defaults. Add a cap (1 MiB) to avoid OOM-ing the target before TCP drop.
